notes.title: Simplified Chinese Translation!

[b]Hello poker enthusiasts![/b]

Today's update adds another language to the game - [b]Simplified Chinese[/b]! 
Big thanks to our amazing translation team who worked hard on this quite difficult task. 

This update makes Simplified Chinese the fourth language available in game, next to English, Russian and Spanish! Japanese and German translations are already in the works as well.

notes.title: Version 1.4.3 update
notes.content:
Version 1.4.3 is out!

In this update, you can now create lobbies for up to 8 players, depending on the mode you choose. If the lobby is full, the game will start when everyone presses Ready. If there are empty spaces in the lobby, the host can also start the game with the current players as soon as they are ready by pressing Play.

In addition, the following character adjustments have been made.

- Lev
-- Bribe: cost 100/75/50 chips => 150/125/100 chips.

- Archie
-- Sniff: will now fully break the ties between Archie and the opponent.

- Arthur
-- White Flag: cost 8/6/4 TP => 8/7/6 TP.

Have fun and join the Discord server!
https://discord.gg/eu9rK2SBer

notes.title: Version 1.4.2 update
notes.content:
Version 1.4.2 is out!
This is a small update that aims to improve the balance of the characters.

- Archie
-- Sniff: gives a point of Confusion should the opponent have better cards. Enters Panic upon reaching 3 points of Confusion.

- Franz
-- Sleeping Pills: cost 4/5/6 TP => 3/4/5 TP.
-- Black Coffee: cost 6/9/12 TP => 6/8/10.
-- Tea Party: cost 6/7/8 TP => 4/5/6 TP.

- Emma
-- Encore: cost 6 TP => 8 TP. Returns with the current amount of her chips if she has less than the base amount.

- Joseph
-- Snipe: cost 75/50/25 chips => 50/75/100 chips. New effect: If the opponent has more chips than Joseph, removes double the amount of chips used (100/150/200). Otherwise, 25 chips are removed.

- Dita
-- Charm: chip gain 50/75/100 => 25/50/75.

- Agatha:
-- Tete-a-tete: now activates only when Agatha is with the opposing player (no longer works with allies).
-- Interview: cost 4/5/6 TP => 4/6/8 TP
-- Blackmail: cost 4/5/6 TP => 4/6/8 TP

notes.title: Spanish Translation - Version 1.4.0 update
notes.content:
Version 1.4.0 is out!

¡Hola!
This update adds a Spanish localization to the game, courtesy of Tobi Fangs, who single-handedly translated over 60,000 words of script! This was not an easy task, but thanks to his dedication and perseverance Spanish speakers can now fully experience the world of Dance of Cards. You can switch to it at any point in the Settings menu.

The following changes have also been made.

[Quality-of-Life]
When one of your hole cards becomes known to your opponents (e.g. as a result of a stressed check or revealed by a Talent), it will have a red outline to help you see which cards are known to your opponents and make better decisions.
In addition, when you perform an action affected by Panic, you will see a notice of the consequences near your character's portrait.

[Character Adjustments]
- Lev
-- Loan: interest 150/225/300 in 3 turns => in 5 turns.

- Douglas
-- Surveillance: duration 3/5/7 turns => 1/2/3 turns.

- Simon
-- Drunk Talk: Sad Drunk TP drain 3/6/9 => 1/2/3.

- Jeanne
-- Hiding: duration 3/4/5 turns => 1/2/3 turns.

- Franz
-- Sleeping Pill: duration 3/4/5 turns => 1/2/3 turns.
-- Black Coffee: TP recovery multiplier is now only effective for two turns at all levels, but boosts Franz's recovery too.

- Joseph
-- Provoke: duration 3/5/7 turns => 3/4/5 turns.
-- Threat: Stress damage increased.

- Esmera
-- Prediction: cost 6/4/2 TP => 4/4/4 TP. Depending on the level of the talent, information about the next card can be hidden from opponents. At level 1, they can see it in full. At level 2, they can only see its suit. At level 3, they can't see it at all and only Esmera knows the next card.
-- Blessing: cost 4/6/8 TP => 4/5/6 TP.
-- Curse: cost 4/6/8 TP => 4/5/6 TP.

- Raymond
-- Taxation: cost 4/6/8 TP => 3/4/5 TP.

- Agatha
-- Blackmail: 50/75/100 chips for an Answer => 25/50/75 chips.

notes.title: Version 1.3.4 update
notes.content:
Version 1.3.4 is out!

This is a small update that adds Blind Increase option to all miscellaneous modes (Quickplay, Honest Poker, Custom Game and Tournament).

notes.title: Version 1.3.3 update
notes.content:
Version 1.3.3 is out!

[New Multiplayer Mode]
In this update, Custom Poker is now available for Online Play. In this mode, you can customise your characters before starting a poker game and set some additional rules:

- Blinds Size (allows you to set the initial size of the blinds)
- Blinds Increase (a toggle that increases the blinds by 25 and 50 after each intermission)
- Last One Standing (if all but one player folds, that player receives extra chips)
- Short Deck (no 2-5 cards in the deck, Flush is higher than Full House)

[New Challenge]
Blinds Increase is now available as a Challenge for Story Mode. As before, you can start the Challenge Mode by either starting a new game after completing Story Mode at least once, or you can activate it in your current playthrough by pressing F10 on the pause screen, then saving and reloading.

[Character Adjustment]
Douglas proved to be quite difficult to deal with in Online Play, so to make him more manageable, the cost of Bluff Shot has been adjusted.
Bluff Shot lvl.2 3 TP => 6 TP
Bluff Shot lvl.3 6 TP => 12 TP

[Bugfixes]
Fixed incorrect behaviour after someone goes all-in when posting a blind.

notes.title: Multiplayer Beta - Version 1.3.0 Update
notes.content:
Version 1.3.0 is out!
In this version, the long-awaited multiplayer mode has finally arrived as a beta!
To try it, go to the Extras menu and select Online Play.
You can play Max Poker (every character is maxed out - it's essentially Quickplay, just under a different name), Honest Poker or Rock, Paper, Bullets. Other modes and games will be added in the future.
Currently, lobbies are limited to two players, one of whom acts as host. Once both players have successfully entered the lobby, they must press Ready and the game of their choice will begin.

Future plans:
- Support for 8-player lobbies
- Spectator mode
- Suit perks support
- Custom Game functionality
- Addition of other Death Gambles

To make it easier to find other players, I've also set up a discord server. You can join it using this link: https://discord.gg/eu9rK2SBer

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 update
notes.content:
Ver 1.2.0 update is out!
This one is beefy. Let’s go through it.

[Quality-of-Life improvement]
To make sure you don't miss a good hand, a special indicator will now remind you when you get at least a pair. Set to On by default, it can be turned off in the Extra Settings.

[New Mode]
Honest Poker is now available. In this mode, characters have minimum luck, talents (both passive and active) are disabled, and no one gets stressed. An honest experience for sure!

[New Mode]
Custom Game is now available. In this mode, you can freely adjust the setup of your characters and opponents. You can set their level, talents and equipment. If you like a particular setup, you can save it and return to it later.

[New Mode]
Last but not least is the addition of Challenge Mode. When you start a new game, you'll be given the option of starting in either Normal Mode or Challenge Mode (assuming you've completed the game at least once).
In Challenge Mode, you can turn on a variety of handicaps that will add a new twist to your gameplay, including increased enemy stats, decreased ally stats, level one lock, disabled talents, disabled panic and a fold penalty.
While most of the options are self-explanatory, I need to explain how the fold penalty works. If all but one opponent folds, that opponent gets extra chips.
You can turn any of these options on or off as you wish.
Challenge Mode can also be activated in a current playthrough without starting a new one, if you want to try it out right away. Press pause, press F10, then save and reload. If everything went well, you will see a Challenges sub-menu added to the menu accessed by pressing C/Y.
If you have any ideas for additional challenges, please let me know and I will see if I can add them.

notes.title: Version 1.1.2 update
notes.content:
A small update that (hopefully) fixes the crashes.
If they are still happening, try two things:
1) If you are using the Steam overlay, try disabling it.
2) Try using the GLES3 branch. Right click on Dance of Cards in your library, select Properties, highlight the Betas tab and pick the GLES3 build.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
Version 1.1.0 is out

Changelog:
[New Feature]
An Extra menu has been added to Settings with toggles for Prestige Victory and Card Reveal

[New Feature]
Prestige Victory - If there is only one opponent left in the game and you have a significant chip lead, you can declare a Prestige Victory should you win a hand. In this case, your opponent is conceded and eliminated from the game. This option is set to On by default.
[New Option]
Card Reveal - If you want to save yourself from suffering the mental damage of realizing you just folded your Full House to a bunch of nothing, you can toggle the card reveal so that the cards are only shown when two or more players actually go to a showdown at the end of the hand. This option is set to Always show by default.

[Character Adjust]
Appetite, Quentyn's passive, has been reworked to increase TP recovery after each use of Talent (capped at 3). When TP recovery reaches 3, Quentyn receives a new status effect No Appetite, which will reset his TP recovery back to zero in the next hand.

---

Have fun!

notes.title: Dance of Cards release date + new trailer!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
I'm excited to announce that Dance of Cards finally has a release date in sight!
Embark on the maiden voyage of the Magnific with its 16 passengers on April 14, 2023!

[previewyoutube=bBQY5lqx0u4;full][/previewyoutube]

It's been a long road, but it is finally time to clear all moorings and set sail into the world.

Mini FAQ.
Q1) Will I be able to transfer my progress from the demo?
A1) Yes! If you completed the demo at least once (and unlocked Quickplay mode), you will be asked if you want to continue right from its ending when you first boot up the game.

Q2) Will this game have achievements?
A2) Yes! The game will have story-related achievements and bunch of gameplay ones. Still thinking about whether I want players to hunt a legitimate royal flush or not...

Q3) Will there be some kind of post-game?
Q3) You will unlock optional modes once you finish the main campaign.

Q4) Okay, that sounds good, how much will it cost?
Q4) 10$.
